user.title: Connect Portsmouth Water
user.description: Sign in to your Portsmouth Water account. Your email and password are saved in Home Assistant so it can sign in automatically when the supplier session expires. Usage updates every six hours. Protect your Home Assistant configuration and backups.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Portsmouth Water.

abort.no_refresh_token: The portal did not return a refresh token.
abort.no_smart_meter: No active smart water meter found.
abort.wrong_account: Please sign in to the original water account.

init.title: Water usage units
init.description: Choose the unit for daily usage and water dashboard history. Existing readings are converted automatically.
